data.body: 2026-09-26 build-system fix. Root Cargo.toml and desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml (its own workspace root; the repository workspace excludes it, which is why the app never inherited the root's debug = 1) now set [profile.dev]/[profile.test] debug = 1, incremental = false, plus build-override debug = false, incremental = false. Rationale: Cargo never prunes incremental sessions and every build flavour (build/check/clippy/test/tauri dev) added another ~250 MB session dir (307 dirs = 77.5 GB); build scripts left 584 exe+pdb pairs. Verified with an equivalent throwaway crate on cargo 1.97.0: lib/test get -Cdebuginfo=1 with no -C incremental, build scripts get -Cstrip=debuginfo. Also added desktop/scripts/native-binary.mjs (link with copyFile fallback) and moved all 22 native-*.mjs scripts from copyFile to stageBinary (163 duplicated ~85 MB app binaries = 13 GB); node --check passes on all 22. Full desktop build not run (offered).
